pages.title: Pressure Wants Out
pages.text: A sealed room retains air. Breaking its wall, opening a door or opening a trapdoor into late-Phase-6 vacuum releases a short burst of airflow. Full glass blocks seal regardless of sunlight. Fences, stairs, single slabs and leaf canopies are not airtight walls.$(br2)A whoosh, loud three-pulse alarm and ORSA voice announce $(bold)WARNING: ATMOSPHERIC BREACH DETECTED$(). Venting particles point toward the opening.

pages.title: Brace, Then Repair
pages.text: The pull lasts about two seconds and weakens. Crouch on the ground to brace. It does not pin you permanently or pull through solid walls.$(br2)Ordinary flames in the connected room snuff together. Torches become $(bold)Spent Torches$() and remain in place, including wall torches. Lanterns stay too. Soul lights remain active.$(br2)A room already vented does not release another burst for each broken block.

pages.title: Life Support
pages.text: Without a full EVA rig and usable oxygen, the existing suffocation buildup begins: lightheadedness after about 1.5 seconds, nausea and slowness after 4, severe slowness after 7, and two hearts of damage each second starting at 10 seconds. Cold can hurt you independently.$(br2)Full EVA with tank O2 or active Emergency EVA reserve keeps supplying air. Empty or partial suits do not. A breach does not automatically puncture the suit.

pages.title: Recovering the Room
pages.text: A Geothermal Core or Blast Pit oxygen source needs connected, sealed room air. Its heat keeps working through a breach; its ambient oxygen protection stops.$(br2)Repair the opening, then allow about five loaded seconds with the oxygen source to restore air. Replacing a block alone or saving and reloading does not refill a vented room. Interrupting the seal restarts recovery.$(br2)Relight spent torches and lanterns with flint and steel once air returns. Campfires and candles use their ordinary controls.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA advises keeping the atmosphere on the inside.$()

pages.title: Sealed Is Not Refilled
pages.text: $(bold)BREACH SEALED — RESTORING AIR$() confirms the room is closed and oxygen recovery is underway. If no connected source is available, the notice instead reads $(bold)OXYGEN SUPPLY REQUIRED$().$(br2)Keep using EVA oxygen until $(bold)ATMOSPHERE RESTORED$() appears with a soft confirmation tone. Recovery takes about five loaded seconds; opening the room interrupts it. The restored notice confirms air, not temperature or repaired suit punctures.$(br2)An EVA helmet shows these notices in its suit HUD. Without an EVA helmet, notices appear above the hotbar. Atmospheric loss is red; recovery is separate. These warnings are not posted to chat.
